detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Colorful Colorado, a state that has some of the best wildlands and mountain ranges in the United States. See a big metropolitan area of Denver on the edge of the Great Plains, travel across the beautiful Rocky Mountains and through deep canyons to see vast desert landscapes around Grand Junction. What you will love about Colorado Forget about the real world in vastness of the Great Plains Roam through the Rocky Mountains Haul cargo on the Million Dollar Highway Discover Colorado's important industries like agriculture and a gold mine Deliver freight to and from the inside of a large cargo aircraft in Denver International Airport Admire accurate representation of cities like Denver and Colorado Springs Visit landmarks like the Four Corners Monument and get a bird's-eye view on it with the viewpoint feature Unlock Colorado-specific Steam achievements Learn more about Colorful Colorado Whet your appetite for this beautiful state by reading more about its diverse nature, industries and cities. Nature Colorado has one of the most unique and varied natural landscapes found in North America. From emerald-green national forests to the incredible red rock formations jutting up from the earth at Garden of the Gods, you’ll find it nearly impossible to resist taking the time out of delivering loads to explore the natural beauty this state has to offer. Don't miss out on a viewpoint in Ouray, the Switzerland of America, which gives you a beautiful view of this Victorian-era mining town! The state is especially famous for its Rocky Mountains, however, much of the eastern part of the region is dominated by a unique grassland that extends across the American continent. The Great Plains is an area that stretches more than eighteen hundred miles from north to south of North America and more than five hundred miles from east to west. Million Dollar Highway Offering views of mountains, valleys and gorges, the Million Dollar Highway is a road like no other. Stretching for around 25 miles (40 km) on the U.S. Highway 550, it has been said that it's one of the nation’s most spectacular drives. The highway delivers jaw-dropping vistas and stunning backdrops on its winding and often dangerous road. So why is this stretch of road named the Million Dollar Highway? There are several stories including that it cost a million dollars a mile to build it and that its fill dirt contains a million dollars in gold ore. Industries Speaking about gold, the state is known for its gold mine located near Colorado Springs where you can haul important mining equipment and waste rock to and from the mining site. Colorado is also home to a variety of bottling plants, each producing and distributing an assortment of different beverages which drivers can deliver to locations across the States. Being a state that promotes its natural beauty, Colorado is always looking at ways of using clean energy to protect the environment. With unique parts and equipment always on the move from the number one wind turbine factory in the USA to wind farms across the States, we hope you will be a BIG fan of this industry. Nearly half of the state's 66 million acres are dedicated just to farms and ranches. Play a key role in contributing to this important economy and exporting the state's produce across the States. From hay bales to farming equipment, truckers will be the backbone of making sure this important and large industry in Cowowado keeps on moo-vin' ! One of the largest contributors to the local economy is Denver International Airport. Drivers can expect to see lots of details around the airport including Denver's famous horse statue. Truckers can also deliver to and from a fan-favorite cargo drop off point, located in the inside of a large cargo aircraft. Cities Nicknamed the Mile High City, Denver features accurate representations of famous landmarks and industries for drivers to discover and deliver cargo to. Denver will also feature a realistic road network, including the famous "mousetrap intersection", the interchange of I-25 and I-70, which is best known for its spaghetti-like design. Located at the foot of Pikes Peak, you'll find the city of Colorado Springs, the state's 2nd most populous city. Colorado Springs is known for its many one-of-a-kind attractions, the most iconic being the city's Garden of the Gods Park, a National Natural Landmark. Featuring 300 million years worth of geological history and incredible towering red sandstone rock formations, it is no wonder it is ranked top of the list of best parks to visit in the US. Try to find a hidden road that will take you there!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 欢迎来到多彩的科罗拉多，一个拥有美国最佳荒野和山脉的州。在大平原的边缘看见丹佛大都市，游览优美的落基山，并穿越深深的峡谷欣赏大章克申附近的荒漠景致。 你将会爱上科罗拉多州 在辽阔的大平原忘记现实生活 漫游落基山 运输货物行驶在百万美金公路 探索科罗拉多州的重要产业，例如风力发电场、金矿场 运送货物至丹佛国际机场的大型货机中，或从这里运出 欣赏丹佛、科罗拉多斯普林斯等城市的真实美景 参观四角落州纪念处等地标，并使用观光点功能鸟瞰风景 解锁科罗拉多州专属 Steam 成就 探索科罗拉多州的城市 进一步了解多彩的科罗拉多 通过了解这里多样的自然景观、产业及城市，激起你对美丽的科罗拉多州的兴趣吧。 大自然 科罗拉多州拥有北美最独特、最多样的自然景观。从翠绿的国家森林到众神花园里令人惊叹的从地底探出的红色岩石，你们会发现自己禁不住地想在货运途中抽出时间，探索科罗拉多州美丽的自然景观。别错过乌雷市（“美国小瑞士”）的观光点，这里可以一览维多利亚时代采矿小镇的美景！ 百万美金公路 拥有山脉、山谷及峡谷美景的百万美金公路是一条独一无二的道路。长约25英里（40公里）的它更被称为美国风景最壮丽的驾车路线之一（这是有充分理由的）。这里还有着关于其多风、危险道路的令人震惊的背景故事。 那么，为什么这段公路被称作百万美金公路呢？有的说建造这条公路每英里花费一百万美金，也有的说其填充的泥土里有一百万美金的金矿。 产业 说到黄金，科罗拉多州以其位于科罗拉多斯普林斯附近的金矿场而闻名。你可以穿梭于采矿地和其它地方之间，运输重要的采矿设备与废石。科罗拉多州同时也是多家饮料厂的所在地，每家生产各种不同的饮料，再由驾驶员运送至其它各州。 作为宣传自然美景的科罗拉多州，一直在探索使用清洁能源保护环境。该州投入的众多项目之一就是将风能作为主要能源。你可以从美国最大的风力发电机制造厂运输各种独特的部件与设备至其他各州，希望你将成为该产业的“大”粉丝。 科罗拉多州有近一半地方/6600万英亩的土地被用作农场、牧场。在这一重要经济中扮演关键角色，协助运输该州作物至其它各州吧。从干草捆到农用机械，卡车司机们将是确保科罗拉多州这个重要大产业持续运转的坚强后盾！ 当地经济最大的贡献者之一是丹佛国际机场。驾驶员们可以期待在机场周边看到大量的细节内容，其中包括丹佛著名的蓝色野马雕像。卡车司机们还可以在你们最喜欢的大型货机内部的货运点与其它地点之间运送货物。 城市 被称为里高城的丹佛有真实重现的著名地标与产业区，等待着大家去探索和运输货物。丹佛还将拥有真实的路网，包括以其意大利面式设计而闻名的“捕鼠器立交”，I-25 与 I-27 的交叉路口以其类似意大利面的设计最为出名。 在派克峰山脚，大家会发现仅次于丹佛的科罗拉多州第二大城市——科罗拉多斯普林斯。科罗拉多斯普林斯以其众多独特的景点而出名，其中最具标志性的是一处国家自然地标——众神花园。拥有3亿年地质史和令人震惊的红砂岩结构的它，无愧于美国最值得参观公园榜榜首的位置。努力去发现一条会引导你来到这里的隐藏道路吧！

detailed_descriptions.ja: カラフルなコロラドへようこそ。ここは、アメリカでも有数の自然と山脈を誇る州です。グレートプレーンズの端にあるデンバーの大都市圏を見て回り、美しいロッキー山脈を越え、深い渓谷を抜けてグランドジャンクション周辺の広大な砂漠の風景を眺めましょう。 コロラドの魅力 広大なグレートプレーンズで現実世界を忘れる ロッキー山脈を歩き回る ミリオンダラーハイウェイで貨物を運ぶ 農業や金鉱など、コロラドの重要な産業を探索する デンバー国際空港で大型貨物機の内部から貨物を配送する デンバーやコロラドスプリングスなどの都市の正確な描写を鑑賞する フォーコーナーズモニュメントなどのランドマークを訪れ、ビューポイント機能で鳥瞰する コロラド固有の実績をロック解除しましょう コロラドの都市を探索する
detailed_descriptions.ko: 미국에서 가장 아름다운 자연과 산맥이 있는 주, 컬러풀 콜로라도에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 대평원 가장자리에 있는 덴버의 대도시권을 구경하고, 아름다운 로키 산맥을 가로질러 여행하고, 깊은 협곡을 지나 그랜드 정션 주변의 광활한 사막 풍경을 감상하세요. 콜로라도에서는 다음과 같은 것이 마음에 드실 겁니다. 대평원의 광활함 속에서 현실 세계를 잊으세요 로키 산맥을 탐험하세요 밀리언달러 고속도로로 화물을 운반하세요 농업 및 금광과 같은 콜로라도의 중요한 산업을 발견하세요 덴버 국제공항의 대형 화물 항공기 내부에 화물을 운송하세요 덴버와 콜로라도 스프링스와 같은 도시의 정확한 표현을 감상하세요 포 코너스 기념비와 같은 랜드마크를 방문하고 전망대 기능으로 조감도를 감상하세요 콜로라도 관련 업적을 잠금 해제하세요 콜로라도의 도시들을 발견하세요

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Colorful Colorado, a state that has some of the best wildlands and mountain ranges in the United States. See a big metropolitan area of Denver on the edge of the Great Plains, travel across the beautiful Rocky Mountains and through deep canyons to see vast desert landscapes around Grand Junction.

What you will love about Colorado

  • Forget about the real world in vastness of the Great Plains

  • Roam through the Rocky Mountains

  • Haul cargo on the Million Dollar Highway

  • Discover Colorado's important industries like agriculture and a gold mine

  • Deliver freight to and from the inside of a large cargo aircraft in Denver International Airport

  • Admire accurate representation of cities like Denver and Colorado Springs

  • Visit landmarks like the Four Corners Monument and get a bird's-eye view on it with the viewpoint feature

  • Unlock Colorado-specific Steam achievements

Learn more about Colorful Colorado

Whet your appetite for this beautiful state by reading more about its diverse nature, industries and cities.

Nature

Colorado has one of the most unique and varied natural landscapes found in North America. From emerald-green national forests to the incredible red rock formations jutting up from the earth at Garden of the Gods, you’ll find it nearly impossible to resist taking the time out of delivering loads to explore the natural beauty this state has to offer. Don't miss out on a viewpoint in Ouray, the Switzerland of America, which gives you a beautiful view of this Victorian-era mining town!

The state is especially famous for its Rocky Mountains, however, much of the eastern part of the region is dominated by a unique grassland that extends across the American continent. The Great Plains is an area that stretches more than eighteen hundred miles from north to south of North America and more than five hundred miles from east to west.

Million Dollar Highway

Offering views of mountains, valleys and gorges, the Million Dollar Highway is a road like no other. Stretching for around 25 miles (40 km) on the U.S. Highway 550, it has been said that it's one of the nation’s most spectacular drives. The highway delivers jaw-dropping vistas and stunning backdrops on its winding and often dangerous road.

So why is this stretch of road named the Million Dollar Highway? There are several stories including that it cost a million dollars a mile to build it and that its fill dirt contains a million dollars in gold ore.

Industries

Speaking about gold, the state is known for its gold mine located near Colorado Springs where you can haul important mining equipment and waste rock to and from the mining site. Colorado is also home to a variety of bottling plants, each producing and distributing an assortment of different beverages which drivers can deliver to locations across the States.

Being a state that promotes its natural beauty, Colorado is always looking at ways of using clean energy to protect the environment. With unique parts and equipment always on the move from the number one wind turbine factory in the USA to wind farms across the States, we hope you will be a BIG fan of this industry.

Nearly half of the state's 66 million acres are dedicated just to farms and ranches. Play a key role in contributing to this important economy and exporting the state's produce across the States. From hay bales to farming equipment, truckers will be the backbone of making sure this important and large industry in Cowowado keeps on moo-vin'!

One of the largest contributors to the local economy is Denver International Airport. Drivers can expect to see lots of details around the airport including Denver's famous horse statue. Truckers can also deliver to and from a fan-favorite cargo drop off point, located in the inside of a large cargo aircraft.

Cities

Nicknamed the Mile High City, Denver features accurate representations of famous landmarks and industries for drivers to discover and deliver cargo to. Denver will also feature a realistic road network, including the famous "mousetrap intersection", the interchange of I-25 and I-70, which is best known for its spaghetti-like design.

Located at the foot of Pikes Peak, you'll find the city of Colorado Springs, the state's 2nd most populous city. Colorado Springs is known for its many one-of-a-kind attractions, the most iconic being the city's Garden of the Gods Park, a National Natural Landmark. Featuring 300 million years worth of geological history and incredible towering red sandstone rock formations, it is no wonder it is ranked top of the list of best parks to visit in the US. Try to find a hidden road that will take you there!

科罗拉多州有近一半地方/6600万英亩的土地被用作农场、牧场。在这一重要经济中扮演关键角色，协助运输该州作物至其它各州吧。从干草捆到农用机械，卡车司机们将是确保科罗拉多州这个重要大产业持续运转的坚强后盾！

当地经济最大的贡献者之一是丹佛国际机场。驾驶员们可以期待在机场周边看到大量的细节内容，其中包括丹佛著名的蓝色野马雕像。卡车司机们还可以在你们最喜欢的大型货机内部的货运点与其它地点之间运送货物。

被称为里高城的丹佛有真实重现的著名地标与产业区，等待着大家去探索和运输货物。丹佛还将拥有真实的路网，包括以其意大利面式设计而闻名的“捕鼠器立交”，I-25 与 I-27 的交叉路口以其类似意大利面的设计最为出名。

进一步了解多彩的科罗拉多

通过了解这里多样的自然景观、产业及城市，激起你对美丽的科罗拉多州的兴趣吧。

科罗拉多州拥有北美最独特、最多样的自然景观。从翠绿的国家森林到众神花园里令人惊叹的从地底探出的红色岩石，你们会发现自己禁不住地想在货运途中抽出时间，探索科罗拉多州美丽的自然景观。别错过乌雷市（“美国小瑞士”）的观光点，这里可以一览维多利亚时代采矿小镇的美景！
